ModMetaData.name: Faction Lens
ModMetaData.author: CoolNether123
ModMetaData.description:
Faction Lens makes the world map readable at a glance by adding relationship-colored names below settlements, sites, abandoned locations, and compatible modded world objects.
Labels update immediately when diplomacy or ownership changes. Configure every category color, apply a colorblind-friendly palette, choose which object types participate, and optionally add a compact legend, dark nameplate, or text outline. Ownership that vanilla does not disclose remains unknown.
Faction Lens changes no diplomacy mechanics or save data and never recolors vanilla icons.
